question: What Are the Main Parts of a Control Valve?
body_html:
The main parts of a control valve are the body, trim, bonnet, actuator and positioner. The body and trim handle the process fluid, while the actuator and positioner move the stem to the position the controller asks for.

PartFunction
Valve bodyPressure containing housing that connects to the pipeline
Trim (plug, seat, cage, stem)Parts in the flow path that set the flow area
Bonnet and packingCloses the top of the body and seals the moving stem
ActuatorDiaphragm or piston that turns air pressure into stem movement
PositionerCompares the 4 to 20 mA command with actual stem position and corrects it
AccessoriesLimit switches, solenoid valve, air filter regulator
